the identification of the structural determinants of schwannomin that mediate its interaction with the cytoskeleton and the membrane.
the identification of a new function of schwannomin, which is to anchor the cytoskeleton to the plasma membrane.
the molecular basis of the NF2 tumor suppressor function.

the tumor suppressive activity of schwannomin is based on its ability to interact with the actin based cytoskeleton.

schwannomin is an actin-binding protein that is located underneath the plasma membrane and that it is involved in a link between the actin-based cyto-skeleton and the membrane.
